title: MultiPragEval: Multilingual Pragmatic Evaluation of Large Language Models

live_model.evidence: "GPT-4 turbo-2024-04-09" (Table 4, model versions); "GPT-4 65.00 83.89 82.22 70.00 75.28 72.50 81.25 68.75" (Table 5, scores by maxim and language)

prompt.location: Table 12 (actual prompt with a test unit)

claim.metric: score (% correct answers, average of 3 trials), English overall
claim.location: Table 5, row GPT-4, English Avg. (German 72.50, Korean 81.25, Chinese 68.75)

notes: Soft gap: correctness of free-form answers is rated by humans (inter-rater agreement in Table 13), so re-execution needs human scoring. Temperature 0.5, three trials averaged.

resolution.plan: The gap is human rating of free-form answers. Take the 300 English test units (context, statement, options A-E, answer key) from the released suite; build each prompt exactly as Table 12 (context, statement, 'Choose the most appropriate meaning of the above utterance from the following options.', options). Query gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0.5 three times, extract the chosen option automatically (letter or option text, LLM fallback) and score against the key; average the three trials and compare with 75.28 (Table 5).
resolution.approximation: Automatic option extraction replaces the three human ratings (Fleiss' kappa 0.87 for GPT-4 English, Table 13).
